buildCommand: rustc --edition 2021 --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --crate-type cdylib -C opt-level=3 -C lto=fat -C codegen-units=1 -C panic=abort -A dead_code tools/ai-tuner/bench-wasm.rs -o tools/ai-tuner/target/wasm-bench/engine.wasm

runs.parity: all JS, WASM and WASM replay moves matched fixture

methodology.statistic: median of batch mean milliseconds per call over 50 positions
methodology.core: positions preloaded; includes one JS-to-WASM call per choice
methodology.replay: rebuild from move history then choose; WASM includes copying moves into linear memory; excludes JSON and Worker messaging
